description:
Step 3A Edge Synthesis: Scans recent project entries with embeddings, finds high-similarity but currently disconnected entries, and creates inferred links as 'synthesized_from'.

**On-Demand Graph Enrichment**: Use this tool periodically to discover semantic relationships between structurally disconnected memory nodes. It batch processes the newest active entries.

max_entries.description: Maximum number of recent entries to scan as sources. Default: 50. Max cap: 50.

max_neighbors_per_entry.description: Maximum number of links to synthesize per source entry. Default: 3. Max cap: 5.

randomize_selection.description: If true, randomly sample active entries instead of taking the newest (default false). Ideal for wide-coverage background sweeps.

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity score (0.0 to 1.0) to create a link. Default: 0.7.

name: session_synthesize_edges
